annotations.title: Compare a sub-account with a snapshot export

description: Compare a supplied snapshot export with this sub-account's live custom values, custom fields, tags and calendars. Include the snapshot ID and at least one asset category. The export is user-supplied; its ownership and freshness are unverified. Missing categories remain unverified. This does not overwrite assets.

snapshotExport.description: Snapshot data containing id (or snapshotId), and arrays for customValues, customFields, tags or calendars, directly or under assets/resources. Use an empty array only for a category verified to be empty. Omit unavailable categories. Optional companyId must match the connected company.
